title: Café corner, pen sketch
prompt: A precise architectural pen-and-ink sketch of a corner café on a European street, ruled straight lines, two-point perspective, fine cross-hatching, black ink on white paper, a hanging sign, big shop windows, a street lamp, balconies above
lighting: a warm evening glow that tints the paper around each light; the ink lines stay crisp

markers.object: the street lamp's lantern: the small black ink-drawn lantern hanging from the curved street lamp at the far left, above the pavement
the hanging café sign: the small white rectangular sign with 'CAFÉ' lettering hanging under the awning at the corner

markers.note: the big shop window on the left glowing from inside
markers.object: the big shop window on the left: the large glass storefront window on the left façade of the café, behind the outdoor tables

markers.note: the shop window on the right
markers.object: the shop window on the right: the large glass storefront window on the right façade of the café
this upstairs window: the tall rectangular window on the upper floor of the left façade, above the café awning
